survey.readings: Axis 22.4 degrees counter-clockwise from east, the towered front to the east-north-east. Nave 11.8 m wide, eaves 17.5 m, ridge 23.4 m; aisles 9.3-13 m lean-tos; transepts (12 m wide) to the same ridge; crossing tower walls about 26 m with a pyramid to 35.4 m; chancel to 23.2 m with a semicircular apse (eaves 14 m); low chapels and sacristies 9-12.8 m; towers 6.4 m square, top 36.9 m in 3DBAG (helm); parish hall in front of the north tower, ridge 17.8 m.

facadeRhythm.east-north-east front (Jacob Obrechtstra: Two square towers and a gabled centre. Each tower front, bottom to top: sandstone base to 4.4 m; a blind arcade of six white round-headed panels in brick surrounds (4.7-7.5 m) with a patterned band over it; three slit windows; three tall round-arched windows in deep round-headed brick recesses (13-19.6 m); a chequered band; on the south tower a clock; a belfry of five round-headed openings on colonnettes; a corbelled cornice; a square ogival helm in brick with light stone stripes, ball and cross. Centre: steps; the portal (two wooden doors, a light tympanum, a banded red-brick arch, a brick gabled hood); either side a small door under one arch of the arcade; the rose window (five-circle star tracery) in moulded rings; a gable of diamond-patterned brick with a mosaic at the apex.
facadeRhythm.tower outer faces: As the front from the arcade up (the north tower's outer face is hidden by the parish hall to about 9 m; the south tower's has the base and arcade, and its clock).
facadeRhythm.flanks: Aisles: the white arcade band continued, small flat-headed windows, lean-to roofs; clerestory: paired small arched windows per bay (inferred from the aisle bays; the flanks are only seen obliquely).
facadeRhythm.transept ends: Three tall round-arched windows and an oculus in the gable (RCE 20013792 back view, approximate).
facadeRhythm.back (apse): Semicircular apse of seven facets with five round-arched windows, conical roof; chancel gable above; square crossing tower with three small arched windows a face and a steep pyramid; hipped chapels and lean-to sacristies in the angles with two round stair turrets.
facadeRhythm.parish hall: Gable to the street: one large gridded window upstairs, a roundel, three ground-floor windows (the middle one wider), a mosaic medallion in the gable; red tile roof; side windows and a door (pic3, pic6).

decisions: Plan and heights from BAG/3DBAG; every roof (gables, lean-tos, crossing pyramid, apse half-cone, helms) from intent.
Helm height 8.8 m over a 29.2 m cornice (3DBAG tower top 36.9 m is at the helm shoulder; cross added above).

The tower faces turned to the nave and the aisles carry three belfry openings, not five: with five, the geometry audit read the one beside the front gable as overhanging. Those faces are not photographed.
Church roof colour taken as dark grey from the RCE photos; the low roofs may be red tile in reality (only the parish hall's is clearly red in the colour photos).
